result.instruction: In `debouncer_top`, keep the seven-bit shift history and registered `clean_reg`, but store `~noisy` in the history and reset history to `7'b1111111`. Change the match check to compare history with seven copies of `~noisy`; when it matches, still assign `noisy` to `clean_reg`. Preserve `// @latency 0`, synchronous active-high reset, registered output, and the eighth-consecutive-sample update; accept the candidate only if it passes all gates and strictly improves the incumbent’s routed LUT count.
